title: A Cross-Cultural Comparison of LLM-based Public Opinion Simulation: Evaluating Chinese and U.S. Models on Diverse Societies
reasoning: The study evaluates LLMs on their ability to simulate public opinions regarding issues with significant moral and ethical weight, such as abortion and same-sex marriage. Crucially, the methodology incorporates 'religious beliefs' as a demographic attribute in the simulation prompts to assess how well models represent the perspectives of individuals with varying religious identities.
